dedupe_keys.name: forsyningstilsynet district heating price statistics denmark twice yearly prices of about 400 district heating companies

description: The Danish Utility Regulator, Forsyningstilsynet, publishes twice a year statistics on the consumer prices that district heating companies have notified to it. The statistics cover the roughly 400 Danish district heating companies that supply end users and give the annual price for a standard flat and a standard house, with a weighted national average price. For the statistics at 31 January 2026 the standard house is 130 square metres using 18.1 MWh a year and the standard flat 75 square metres using 15 MWh; the Danish Energy Agency changed these definitions from 1 September 2025 to 125 square metres and 13.4 MWh for a house and 80 square metres and 7.8 MWh for a flat, and the regulator will switch once all companies have reported on the new basis. Each release has a report, company lists sorted alphabetically and by price as PDF, and a CSV file, and earlier releases are available to download free at the bottom of the page. No licence is stated. Coverage is Denmark by company. Caveats: prices are notified budgets, not audited outturns, and definitions change between releases. Simulation uses are district heating tariffs by company for heat planning and affordability studies. Related records: data-energiforetagen-sweden-district-heating-statistics is a Swedish counterpart.
